import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluedClass
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionEnlargement

/-!
# The universal model class on a common Galois-stage carrier

The finite-stage universal classes and the triple-transition maps are enlarged
to one field Galois over the original field. The resulting compatible chart
classes glue on that stage's actual carrier, retaining their comparison with
the ambient universal classes.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option Elab.async false

universe u

open CategoryTheory
open scoped TensorProduct MonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {F K : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
  [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [IsSepClosed K] [IsGalois F K]
  (Ck : Over (Spec (.of K))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom]
  [IsProper Ck.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom]
  (E : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext Ck F)
  (CM : Over (Spec (.of E.models.M.1))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 CM.hom]
  [IsProper CM.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible CM.hom]

local instance : IsScalarTower F E.models.M.1 K :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

local instance (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E.models.M.1 K) :
    IsScalarTower F E.models.M.1 S.stage :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

/-- The actual enlarged Galois-stage carrier carries a class whose restriction
to each model chart recovers the pinned universal class after scalar extension. -/
theorem exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedModelClass
    (i : (baseChange E.models.M.1 K).obj CM ≅ Ck) :
    ∃ (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E.models.M.1 K)
      (h : E.triple.N.1 ≤ S.stage), FiniteDimensional F S.stage ∧ IsGalois F S.stage ∧
      let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F := ⟨E.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext h⟩
      ∃ s : pic0Subgroup CM
          ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap E.models.M.1 S.stage)))).obj P.gluedOver),
        ∀ U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex Ck,
          pic0Map CM (Over.overSpecMap
              (CommAlgCat.ofHom S.inclusion ▷
                pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E.models (Sum.inl U)).hom)
            (pic0Map CM (P.modelChartι Ck U) s) =
              pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass Ck E.models CM i (Sum.inl U) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional F E.models.L.1 := E.models.L.2
  letI : FiniteDimensional E.models.L.1 E.models.M.1 := E.models.M.2
  letI : FiniteDimensional F E.models.M.1 :=
    FiniteDimensional.trans F E.models.L.1 E.models.M.1
  have H :=
    exists_pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass_compatible_isGalois
      (F := F) (K := K) Ck E.models CM i
      (DatG0.FiniteStageData.ofFinSubext E.triple.N)
  rcases H with ⟨S, hS, hG, x, hbc, hx⟩
  letI : FiniteDimensional E.models.M.1 S.stage := S.finiteWitness
  have hfin : FiniteDimensional F S.stage :=
    FiniteDimensional.trans F E.models.M.1 S.stage
  let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F := ⟨E.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext hS⟩
  have hsm : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 CM.hom := inferInstance
  have hpr : IsProper CM.hom := inferInstance
  have hir : GeometricallyIrreducible CM.hom := inferInstance
  have gluer := @Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage.existsUnique_gluedModelClass
    F K _ _ _ _ _ Ck _ _ _ P CM hsm hpr hir
  have classGluer := gluer x
  have hcompat : ∀ j : Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex Ck,
      pic0Map CM (Over.overSpecMap
        (CommAlgCat.of P.context.models.M.1 P.context.triple.N.1 ◁
          pic0FiniteStageModelRestriction Ck P.context.models j).hom)
        (x (Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionSource Ck j)) =
          x (Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionTarget Ck j) := by
    exact hx
  have Hglue := classGluer hcompat
  rcases Hglue with ⟨s, hs, _⟩
  refine ⟨S, hS, hfin, hG, s, ?_⟩
  intro U
  exact (congrArg (pic0Map CM (Over.overSpecMap
    (CommAlgCat.ofHom S.inclusion ▷
      pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E.models (Sum.inl U)).hom))
    (hs U)).trans (hbc (Sum.inl U))

variable (C : Over (Spec (.of F))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
  [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

/-- For a curve over the original field, the common Galois-stage carrier carries
the transported model class, with the ambient chart comparisons preserved. -/
theorem exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedClass
    (E₀ : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext ((baseChange F K).obj C) F) :
    ∃ (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E₀.models.M.1 K)
      (h : E₀.triple.N.1 ≤ S.stage), FiniteDimensional F S.stage ∧ IsGalois F S.stage ∧
      let Ck := (baseChange F K).obj C
      let CM := (baseChange F E₀.models.M.1).obj C
      let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F := ⟨E₀.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext h⟩
      ∃ s : pic0Subgroup CM
          ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap E₀.models.M.1 S.stage)))).obj P.gluedOver),
        ∃ xi : pic0Subgroup ((baseChange F S.stage).obj C) P.gluedOver,
          xi = pic0Pullback ((baseChange.compIso F E₀.models.M.1 S.stage).app C).hom
            P.gluedOver ((pic0CrossBaseEquiv E₀.models.M.1 S.stage CM P.gluedOver).symm s) ∧
          ∀ U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex Ck,
            pic0Map CM (Over.overSpecMap
                (CommAlgCat.ofHom S.inclusion ▷
                  pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E₀.models (Sum.inl U)).hom)
              (pic0Map CM (P.modelChartι Ck U) s) =
                pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass Ck E₀.models CM
                  ((baseChange.compIso F E₀.models.M.1 K).app C).symm (Sum.inl U) := by
  obtain ⟨S, h, hfin, hG, s, hs⟩ :=
    exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedModelClass (F := F) (K := K)
      ((baseChange F K).obj C) E₀
      ((baseChange F E₀.models.M.1).obj C)
      ((baseChange.compIso F E₀.models.M.1 K).app C).symm
  refine ⟨S, h, hfin, hG, s, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨_, rfl, hs⟩

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
